# StudioLight v1.0
## Create Studio (Draft-to-Relight Pipeline)

### Required Model Downloads (Direct Links)

* Diffusion UNET: [flux1-krea-dev_fp8_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/KreaAI/flux1-krea-dev-fp8-scaled/blob/main/flux1-krea-dev_fp8_scaled.safetensors) (or standard flux1-dev / GGUF quants)
* Text Encoders: [clip_l.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/comfyanonymous/flux_text_encoders/blob/main/clip_l.safetensors) + [t5xxl_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/comfyanonymous/flux_text_encoders/blob/main/t5xxl_fp16.safetensors) (or t5xxl_fp8)
* VAE: [ae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev/blob/main/ae.safetensors)
* Surface Normals: [prs-eth/marigold-normals-v1-1](https://huggingface.co/prs-eth/marigold-normals-v1-1) (Auto-downloaded on first run)
* Albedo De-Light: [prs-eth/marigold-iid-lighting-v1-1](https://huggingface.co/prs-eth/marigold-iid-lighting-v1-1) (Auto-downloaded on first run)
* Depth & Masking: [Depth Anything V2 ViT-L](https://huggingface.co/depth-anything/Depth-Anything-V2-Large) + [BiRefNet-general](https://huggingface.co/ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet)

### Quick Start

1. Prompt: Enter subject description in Base Subject Prompt (Green Box). Flux works best with an empty Negative prompt. If adding negative terms, raise CFG to 2.5 - 3.5.
2. Light Rig: Dial light coordinates and Kelvin colors on StudioLightRig. Check the 2D Studio Radar and Chrome Ball for real-time aim feedback.
3. Queue: Pass 1 generates the base subject; Pass 2 synthesizes physical 3D shadows and specular reflections into skin and clothing.

### Calibration Rules

* Pass 2 Denoise (KSampler): 0.48 - 0.55 is the calibrated artist sweet spot for rich skin textures and soft shadow wrapping. Use 0.35 - 0.42 when flipping light direction 180° for strict directional shadow enforcement. Values above 0.60 allow AI diffusion to override 3D lighting.

* DeLight Strength (DeLight Strength): Use 1.00 when changing light direction 180° to completely wipe old shadows from the base plate. Use 0.70 - 0.85 to preserve subtle natural skin ambient occlusion during softer relighting.

* Operating Mode (Consistent Relighting): Use Replace subject light for studio portraits to light the person while keeping the background scenery untouched. Use Add studio light for environmental scenes (caveman, dark rooms, street lamps) to splash physical light onto walls, ceiling, and floor with inverse-square falloff.

* Scene Contract (StudioLight Scene Contract): Auto detects outdoor vs indoor prompts. Set to Open manually to guarantee sky and cloud protection from studio flashes. Set to Enclosed for interior light bounce.

Created by METAMATERIAL / Maciej Tajber (MIT License)

nodes.title: Pass 1  KSampler
widgets_values:
### Pass 1 Draft Steps

Step 10 / 30: Fast preview. Overall geometry is still soft; best for rapid lighting experiments.

Step 15 / 30: Structural shape locked. Surface volumes are stable, but fine facial details may retain slight noise.

Step 20 / 30 (Calibrated Default): Full convergence. Facial anatomy and skin textures are crisp and noise-free, providing optimal surface normals for Marigold.

nodes.title: DE-LIGHT - Marigold
widgets_values:
De-Light Engine

Purpose: Decomposes the draft image into a pure diffuse albedo base plate, stripping out old baked shadows and specular glares so new 3D lights don't create dirty double-shadows.

DeLight Strength: Set to 1.00 when changing light direction 180° for full shadow wipeout. Set to 0.70 - 0.85 to preserve subtle natural skin ambient occlusion for gentle lighting enhancements.

Diagnostic Grid: The 4 inspection cards display estimated Albedo, Original Shading, Non-diffuse Residual, and the physical reconstruction check (A*S+R).

nodes.title: SUBJECT MASK - BiRefNet
widgets_values:
Subject Isolation

Purpose: Automatically segments the subject using BiRefNet-general, ensuring studio strobes only illuminate the model without spilling onto background walls or outdoor scenery.

Edge Softness: Default 0 provides crisp alpha boundaries. Increase to 1 - 2 to soften matte edges around frizzy hair or translucent clothing.

External Mask: Connect a custom mask to subject_mask to override automatic detection, or leave empty for automatic sub-pixel hair and edge separation.

nodes.title: STUDIO LIGHT RIG
widgets_values:
### 3D Rig & Relighting Console

StudioLight Rig: Controls 3 physical studio fixtures (Key, Fill, Rim). Azimuth rotates 360° around the subject; Elevation sets fixture height; Distance sets physical falloff in meters; Kelvin dials color temperature (3200K warm tungsten to 6500K daylight).

Aim Target: Set to Upper (calibrated default) to automatically track the face and eyes. Center targets torso or product; Lower targets the lower third.

Normal Boost: Default 1.35 provides clean 3D facial sculpting without edge seams. Increase to 1.80 - 2.50 for heavy micro-relief textures (armor, stone, coarse fabric).

Consistent Relighting Modes:
  Use Replace subject light for commercial studio portraits to illuminate the model while preserving original background scenery.
  Use Add studio light for environmental scenes (caveman in dark cave, room lamps) to splash physical 3D light across the entire scene volume.

Source Preservation: Active under Replace subject light. Set to 0.00 - 0.05 when flipping light direction 180° to wipe old lighting. Set higher (0.70 - 1.00) to retain original lighting cues and punch in subtle accents.

nodes.title: FLUX guidance
widgets_values:
ARCHIVED CHECKPOINT NOTE: may be stale; see TEST SETTINGS note.

FLUX guidance (Default 3.5)

2.0 – 2.5: More photographic, softer transitions, yields more authority to the 3D lit plate.

3.5 – 4.5: High prompt adherence; enhances crisp edges, but pushing above 4.0 can introduce digital sharpness.

nodes.title: Pass 2 KSampler
widgets_values:
### Pass 2 KSampler (Final Master Synthesis)

Core Function: Governs how much Flux regenerates the image to adopt the 2.5D photometric lighting versus locking the base draft geometry.

0.35 - 0.42 (Strict Directional Lock): Use when flipping light direction 180°. Strictly enforces physical 3D shadow boundaries and locks 100% of facial anatomy and fine skin pores.

Default 0.50): Generatively synthesizes rich subsurface scattering across skin, natural eye catchlights, and authentic specular gleam on fabrics and leather.

0.60 - 0.75+ (High Chiaroscuro): Dramatic diffusion freedom. Allows Flux to create deep, moody shadow roll-off and intense theatrical contrast.

nodes.title: DE-LIGHT - Marigold
widgets_values:
### ENVIRONMENT (Background & Sky Interaction) 

Auto: Automatically parses prompt for indoor vs outdoor cues. 

Open: Outdoors (sky, street, beach). Protects sky and horizon from being lit by studio lights. 

Enclosed: Indoors/Studio (room, cave, stage). Background receives ambient light and wall falloff. 

Mixed: Indoor spaces with large windows, terraces, or open doorways.

### AMBIENT INTENT (Base Tone Calibration) 

Auto: Detects mood keywords (low-key, dusk vs bright daylight). 

Bright: Forces Neutral Diffuse Reference (flat, shadowless studio base). 

Dark: Forces Preserve Environmental Tone (deep blacks and moody ambient base).

### REFINEMENT MODE (Pass 2 FLUX Conditioning) 

Auto: Strips old conflicting lighting keywords and delivers pure scene content to prevent skin or texture artifacts. 

Custom Override: 100% manual control. Sends the text box below verbatim to FLUX with zero automatic modifications.
